intent: To illustrate the high attrition rate of family businesses across generations and introduce a specific chain that has successfully maintained its legacy.

units.meaning: Half of family businesses do not last until the third generation.

basis.entity: family businesses that fail before the third generation
family businesses that fail before the third generation

accepted_routes: Another 50% do not last until the third generation.
Half of family businesses fail before the third generation.
Only about half make it to the third generation.
units.visual_evidence_rule: The highlighted arc must stop at about half of the circle.
units.temporal_anchor: the narration clause introducing the survival/attrition share represented by the blue segment
units.reviewer_question: Should the 50% be required, or is "about half" enough?

optional_valid: The clip may introduce In-N-Out as a specific legacy chain, but this has no numeric basis.
The 50% can be phrased as "about half" or "another fifty percent".
unsupported_to_avoid: The 62%/38% split of the old table; it was a misreading of the arc.
A 33.3% second-generation survival figure: that belongs to the paired clip, not here.
Causal explanations for why family businesses fail.
Extrapolating the 50% to all businesses or all countries.
notes: 与 donut_37 是同一段旁白的两帧：37 记第二个世代的存活率 30%，这里记"another 50% 活不到第三代"。蓝弧几何读数 54.4%，按旁白取 50%。
